evidence.AC1: POST /todos with {"title":"past","dueDate":"2020-01-01"} returned 201 with dueDate "2020-01-01". POST without dueDate returned 201 with dueDate null. The date is a plain YYYY-MM-DD string with no time part.
evidence.AC2: PATCH /todos/2 with {"dueDate":"2020-05-05"} returned 200 and the date changed from 2099-01-01 to 2020-05-05. PATCH /todos/4 set a date, then {"dueDate":null} returned 200 with dueDate null. GET /todos/4 confirmed the removal.
evidence.AC3: POST with dueDate "2026-02-30", "23.10.2026", "2026-10-23T10:00:00Z" and the number 5 each returned 400. PATCH with "2026-02-30" and "bad" also returned 400.
evidence.AC4: Today is 2026-10-23 (UTC). Data: past undone (2020-01-01), future (2099 before edit), due today, no due date, past done. GET /todos?overdue=true returned only the past undone todo (id 1) and todo 2 after its date was changed to 2020-05-05. The due-today todo, the todo without a date and the done todo with a past date (id 5, overdue false after PATCH done:true) were not returned. Invalid ?overdue=maybe returned 400. One oddity: todo 5 was created with done false, so it was correctly overdue until it was marked done.
evidence.AC5: Loaded / in the browser. The list items showed "past Fällig: 2020-01-01 Überfällig", "today Fällig: 2026-10-23" and "pastdone ✓ Fällig: 2020-01-01". The todo without a date showed no due date.
evidence.AC6: In the browser, only the overdue todos (past, and future after its date was changed to 2020-05-05) carried the marker "Überfällig". The due-today, no-date and done todos had none. The marker is capitalised ("Überfällig") instead of lowercase "überfällig"; I judged it as the same word, differing only in sentence-initial capitalisation.
evidence.AC7: The page has a checkbox labelled "nur überfällige". Clicking it reloaded the list to show only "past" and "future" (both overdue). The other three todos disappeared.
